plan.title: Single-stage RFQ attachments and vendor access

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique title.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publication.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, select the product CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB if it is not already selected, confirm Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), and attach the two named documents Technical Specification Sheet.pdf and Bidding Sheet Template.xlsx; stop when both attachments are visibly listed on the create screen

steps.note: Handle the exact product variant, delivery location, and named attachment uploads that no dedicated catalog step can fully express.
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Add the vendor named in the case before publishing.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Open the project details view required by the expected result.
Verify the buyer’s project details list two quotation-template attachments.
Verify that both listed documents have download links for the buyer.
Switch to the invited vendor’s supplier-portal view.
Open the event overview where vendor attachments are available.
Verify the vendor can see both attachments.
Download the technical specification attachment from the vendor view.
Verify the vendor download has the expected filename.
Download the bidding sheet attachment from the vendor view.
Verify the vendor download has the expected filename.
